_comment: The GBFS field vocabulary per shape, as a ratchet against the frontend.
The mapping editor offers exactly these fields and marks exactly these as
required, and nothing on the wire carries them, so this file is what holds
the two copies together. Changing the serializer fails the vocabulary tests
in test_gbfs_serializer.py and test_gbfs_serializer_vehicles.py; update the
frontend in the same change, then update this. Same shape and intent as
The vocabulary is version-neutral: 2.3 and 3.0 differ in spelling on the
wire, not in the fields a binding maps.
